programme.title: Mentes criminales

programme.title: Dr. Pimple Popper
programme.desc: 'S1/E4 - This Cyst Persists'. Half of Mary's body is a size 18 while the other is an 8. Anthony's cyst is in the area called the Triangle of Death, and Shane wants to get a lump off his back.

programme.title: Filthy Fortunes
programme.desc: 'S1/E2 - Amping Up The Mess And Money'. Matt takes on a rock star mess to find classic guitars and amps, vintage trucks and rare Harleys. The hoard's heavy metal puts the team at risk.

programme.title: Unexpected: Teenage & Pregnant
programme.desc: 'S2/E13 - Papa Was A Rolling Stone'. Chloe brings Ava home without Max and Mckayla has some big news to share with Tim. Plus, Tylor has a very big question to ask.

programme.title: Unexpected: Teenage & Pregnant
programme.desc: 'S2/E14 - Tell All'. Host Ricki Lake unites the five families to discuss the drama of the past year. Secrets are revealed, breakups explained, and one couple has a surprising announcement.

programme.title: Unexpected: Teenage & Pregnant
programme.desc: 'S3/E1 - We're Back, Baby'. McKayla is back with her second pregnancy. Chloe deals with the possibility of Max going to jail. And, Tyra, 18, worries about the health of her baby.

programme.title: The Bad Skin Clinic
programme.desc: 'S8/E4 - You're Growing A Good Crop'. Chris arrives at clinic with 120 painful skin tags. Jakki has spent 13k searching for answers about her extremely red and swollen face.

programme.title: 90 Day Fianc UK
programme.desc: 'S4/E7 - I'm An Evil Genius'. Shorna's rapidly losing faith in Adnand. Zena's dancing feet get her into trouble, and Anglophile Ali's got an Evil Genius Plan to get the UK.

programme.title: Little People, Big World
programme.desc: 'S15/E3 - Battle Ground'. Zach and Tori skip pumpkin season at the farm to focus on Jackson, who needs surgery for his bowed legs. Chris gets off to a rocky start as a wagon tour guide.

programme.title: 7 Little Johnstons
programme.desc: 'S7/E8 - How Do You Say Joose?'. Trent starts his new career, and Alex, Emma and Amber are back in school. Plus, Trent and Amber consider a new addition to the household.

programme.title: Cake Boss
programme.desc: 'S6/E7 - From Russia With Cake'. Buddy is asked to make a cake recreation of St. Basil's Cathedral in Moscow. Meanwhile, Buddy's sister tries to stop the feud between Ashley and Paul.

programme.title: Cake Boss
programme.desc: 'S6/E8 - Fire And Ice'. Ashley and Buddy go head-to-head on a fire and ice cake challenge. A survivor of an accident makes a special request for a cake to the heroes that saved his life.

programme.title: Kitchen Boss
programme.desc: 'S2/E3 - Aunt Anna's Visit'. Buddy makes some of his family's favourite comfort foods with his Auntie Anna and Uncle Cosmo. And Auntie Anna makes her famous frittata with onions and peppers.

programme.title: My 600-lb Life
programme.desc: 'S10/E6 - Stephanie's Journey'. With her weight spiralling, Stephanie needs her mum's help to care for her three kids. Now, she must lose weight if she's to see her kids grow up.

programme.title: 90 Day: Hunt For Love
programme.desc: 'S2/E4 - The Girl Who Fell Off Her Stool'. Emma comes on strong with Jamal, Steven makes his move on Iris despite Razvan's efforts, and Michael asks someone out for the first time in two years.

programme.title: 90 Day: Hunt For Love
programme.desc: 'S2/E4 - Sheet Talking: The Girl Who Fell Off Her Stool'. The cast gives their candid opinions and the lowdown on the previous episode's drama - and no-one is holding back!

programme.title: Chimp Crazy
programme.desc: 'S1/E2 - Gone Ape'. PETA launches an investigation after a former Hollywood chimp named Tonka goes missing. It's a high-stakes legal battle, particularly in light of a brutal chimp attack years earlier on a Connecticut woman.

programme.title: James Acaster: Hecklers Welcome

programme.title: Get Me To 21 The Jenna Lowe Story
programme.desc: A moving, inspiring, and informative documentary about Gabi Lowe and her family's four-year battle to save her terminally ill daughter Jenna.

programme.title: Juliet & Romeo
programme.desc: Shakespeare's classic tale of forbidden love is rendered into a lively and vibrant pop musical.

programme.title: Adulthood

programme.title: Preschool

programme.title: Chimp Crazy
programme.desc: 'S1/E4 - Fantasy Island'. A shocking finale. Tonka's fate becomes clearer while Tonia struggles to let go and dreams of opening her own island sanctuary where she can live among chimpanzees.

programme.title: Marc Maron: Panicked

programme.title: Old Guy

programme.title: Sing 2

programme.title: Epic Tails
